units.source_text: 也许是这个原因，所以恢复起来也快。

en.t: Perhaps that was the reason, and so his recovery was quick as well.

units.source_text: 到了第四天，腿上、腰部的疼痛感几乎都消失了。

en.t: By the fourth day, the pain in his legs and lower back had almost completely disappeared.

units.source_text: 第五天，除了还有些疲惫感觉以外，再没有什么可以称得上自觉症状了。

en.t: On the fifth day, apart from still feeling somewhat tired, he had nothing that could really be called a subjective symptom.

units.source_text: 然而，他还是赖在床上，装成个重病人，不用说有他的理由和打算。

en.t: Even so, he stayed in bed and pretended to be seriously ill; needless to say, he had his reasons and his plans.

units.source_text: 当然，他并没有放弃逃跑的计划。

en.t: Of course, he had not given up his plan to escape.
